title: Interactive mission-based onboarding for Console: scenario-driven setup and checkpoints
creator: Ava Patel
description: Goal: Design a mission-based onboarding layer in the Console that teaches new users by walking them through realistic scenarios ("Create a test project", "Deploy a canary rollout", "Analyze cost per route") rather than abstract checklist steps. Missions are lightweight, stateful sequences of 3–6 in-product steps with progress tracking, contextual tips, and a success badge. The outcome should reduce time-to-first-successful-inference workflow and improve retention for teams evaluating Redwood Dedicated/Private.
updates: 2025-11-03: Kickoff — aligned on goals with PM and Eng. Scoped MVP to two mission types: 'Starter project' and 'Cost literacy for rollouts'.
2025-11-06: Low-fidelity flows reviewed with Growth — agreed to avoid modal-heavy patterns; prefer anchored to console nav and per-route cards.
2025-11-07: Prototype v0 in Figma created (missions panel, progress state, inline hints). Shared link with research for guerrilla testing.
2025-11-10: Usability test (6 participants) — main friction: unclear exit/skip path; positive signals around 'reward' badge and automated sample snippets.
2025-11-12: Stakeholder review — Eng flagged offline state handling and analytics events; PM requested success metric hooks for A/B rollout.
design_decisions: Missions are persistent per-team and surfaced in the Console's primary empty state and via a 'Missions' tab to avoid modal fatigue.
Each mission step should include a 'Try it with sample data' inline action that inserts a lightweight sandbox snippet into the current context (no account billing changes).
Progress is tracked server-side to allow cross-device continuation; progress events will be emitted through an analytics hook (ENG dependency).
Visual reward: small badge + copy changes on the dashboard to show 'Completed 1 of 2 missions' rather than full-page banners.
Accessibility: all steps must be keyboard-navigable and screen-reader friendly; tooltip text doubles as accessible instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Clickable mission entry appears in Console empty states for users with < 2 projects and is dismissible.
Users can complete a 3-step 'Starter project' mission end-to-end using sample assets within 10 minutes without reading external docs.
Frontend prototype validated in two rounds of usability tests with clear improvement in task completion vs baseline (+22% on first-successful-inference).
Event hooks emitted for step-start, step-complete, mission-complete accessible to Analytics and Growth teams.
Design handoff includes final Figma, interaction specs, copy deck, and accessibility checklist.
stakeholder_feedback: PM (Ethan Jacobs): Prefer lightweight missions that can be toggled off in org settings; important to include A/B hooks for measuring conversion to paid plans.
Eng (Priya Shah): Will need an API for progress persistence and an offline-safe fallback if the progress service is unreachable.
Growth (Sabrina Cole): Suggests adding inline templates targeted by persona (platform engineer vs ML engineer) in later iteration.
Design review (Lead): Approve overall concept but request tighter copy and microcopy iterations to reduce cognitive load.
